items.headline: CISA Flags Actively Exploited Ray Flaw That Can Trigger Browser-Based RCE

items.headline: Joint Board of Appeal dismisses appeal against the EBA
items.summary: Joint Board of Appeal dismisses appeal against the EBA 16 July 2026 Board of Appeal The Joint Board of Appeal of the European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, EIOPA and ESMA – the ESAs) has issued a decision stating that an appeal brought by an individual against the European Banking Authority (EBA) is inadmissible.
